encoding: series[s]["YYYY-MM"] = "di,dj,n;di,dj,n;..." with tile row ti = i0 + di and tile column tj = j0 + dj (tile of the ~1 km cell centre, see manifest grid); tile covers lat [ti*0.5, ti*0.5+0.5), lon [tj*0.5, tj*0.5+0.5); n = cell-days. Only non-zero tiles/months are stored. totals[s]["YYYY-MM"] = unique cell-days in the country file (equals the sum of that month’s tiles).
unit: cell-day: ~1 km cell (0.009 deg lat x 0.014 deg lon, cell = floor(lat/0.009), floor(lon/0.014)) with >= 1 type-0 detection on that acq_date (UTC)
